game.name: Genshin Impact
game.notes: Version 7.1 'A Rekviem for the Underworld' live since 2026-09-23; 6th anniversary celebrations run through the version. Version 7.2 release and Special Program dates have not been officially announced; projections are intentionally omitted.

events.title: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
events.summary: Version 7.1 flagship Moonchase Festival event in Liyue, awarding the event-exclusive 4-star sword Silver Light and 950 Primogems. Ended 2026-10-12.
events.description: The Moonchase Festival arrived at Yilong Wharf with a story involving Zhongli, Zibai and an old mystery told across the 'A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon' event quest and 'Wondrous Anecdotes' side stories. Three thaumaturge-themed gameplay modes were available: 'The Great Chase and Dispelling', 'Banner Against the Dark' and 'Spiritshot Salvo'. Completing modes and quests earned 'Festive Cheer', traded for the event-exclusive 4-star sword Silver Light, its refinement material Tea-Scented Tassel, Primogems, a Crown of Insight and upgrade materials.
events.gameplay: Guide a rattan figure through obstacle courses, clear combat score stages using Banners, and fire Spiritshots at enemy waves; accumulate Festive Cheer to unlock the reward track.
requirements: Adventure Rank 20 or above
Complete Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"
Recommended: Story Quests "Dulciaria Structura Chapter: Act I" and "Tapirus Somniator Chapter: Act I" and event quest "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon"

event-exclusive 4-star Sword, unlocked at 200 Festive Cheer

events.title: Rainbow's End: Resplendent Starlight
events.summary: 6th anniversary gift event: 1,600 Primogems by in-game mail plus a 7-day login check-in with 10 Intertwined Fates.
events.description: The anniversary celebration has three parts: a Crystal Top-Up Bonus Reset, the 'Missive of Grace: A Thank-You Gift' mail drop (2026/09/28 until the end of Version 7.1, each mail claimable for 30 days), and the 'Resplendent Starlight' daily login event (2026/10/01 - 2026/10/19). Mail arrives over four days with 400 Primogems each day plus a pet, Fragile Resin, a Sanctifying Elixir and a gadget; the login card pays 10 Intertwined Fates across seven logins.
events.gameplay: Log in to claim mail and check in on seven separate days during the login window to collect each slot.
requirements: Adventure Rank 2 or above (mail)
Adventure Rank 5 or above (daily login)
events.rewardsSummary: 1,600 Primogems + 10 Intertwined Fates + 80,000 Mora + 8 Hero's Wit + 1 Dust of Enlightenment + 2 Fragile Resin + 1 Sanctifying Elixir + Conductor of the "Ya-ho" pet + Mini Trolley Problem gadget (20 pulls total)

events.title: Across the Frozen Wilds, Honing One's Edge
events.summary: Anniversary giveaway: invite one free standard-banner 5-star character of your choice plus their ascension materials.
events.description: A recurring anniversary event that lets every Traveler invite a 5-star character from the standard wish 'Wanderlust Invocation' via the event interface, one invite per account. Inviting a character also grants Ascension Level-Up Materials for that character (enough to raise them to Lv. 60). The pool covers Jean, Diluc, Qiqi, Mona, Keqing, Tighnari, Dehya and Yumemizuki Mizuki. Per the official notice, Travelers who register after Version 7.1 ends can invite a standard 5-star in a subsequent run of the event during Version 7.x.
events.gameplay: Open the event interface and select one character to invite permanently to your roster.
requirements: Unlocked the Wish feature

rewards.note: choice of Jean, Diluc, Qiqi, Mona, Keqing, Tighnari, Dehya or Yumemizuki Mizuki

events.title: Tabletop Troupe: A Gathering on Adventure's Eve
events.summary: Anniversary event giving one free limited-event 5-star character from a set pool, unlocked after the 7.1 Archon Quest.
events.description: A tabletop-roleplaying-themed anniversary event in which the Traveler gathers the Tabletop Troupe. It awards a free event-exclusive 5-star character from a fixed pool - Tartaglia, Nilou, Baizhu, Chiori, Clorinde or Varesa - together with the materials needed to raise them to Lv. 60. The invite only unlocks after completing the Version 7.1 Archon Quest, so it pairs with the 'A Rekviem for the Underworld' story event.
events.gameplay: Progress the event's tabletop adventure, then claim one permanent 5-star character invite from the event interface.

events.title: Complete Archon Quest "A Rekviem for the Underworld" Within the Specified Duration
events.summary: Time-limited completion bonuses for finishing Archon Quest Chapter VII Acts III and IV during Version 7.1.
events.description: Archon Quest Chapter VII: Act III "White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking" and Act IV "A Rekviem for the Underworld" became permanently available with the Version 7.1 update. Completing them within the specified duration grants additional Primogems, Character Ascension Materials, Character Level-Up Materials and Snezhnaya regional specialties. Finishing Act IV in time also unlocks a time-limited Epilogue quest for the series (available until 2026-11-03).
events.gameplay: Follow the Snezhnaya Archon Quest storyline and complete Acts III and IV before the deadline to receive the bonus rewards in mail.

events.title: Anniversary Memories Album
events.summary: 6th anniversary web event looking back at your Teyvat journey: 160 Primogems from the three main activities plus hidden Easter eggs worth at least 20 more.
events.description: A browser-based 6th anniversary event in which Paimon looks back on your journey through Teyvat. Three main activities - the Anniversary Memories Album, the 'Theater of Memories' highlight reel and the 'Starfarer's Almanac' Adventure Style generator - each pay Primogems and materials, a share task pays Mora, and hidden Easter eggs add 'Primogems ×20 and more'. Rewards arrive by in-game mail (30-day claim window). It also includes a theme song sung by Childe's English voice actor.
events.gameplay: Open the web event page, browse the three album activities, share once and hunt the hidden Easter eggs, then claim the reward chest.
requirements: Adventure Rank 10 or above

events.title: Starlit Gala (Miliastra Wonderland)
events.summary: Anniversary celebration around the Miliastra Wonderland UGC mode, with Primogems, Geodes of Replication and cosmetics across its in-game and web reward tracks.
events.description: The Starlit Gala is the reward track of the Miliastra Wonderland anniversary celebration, running from the Version 7.1 update until 2026-11-03. Special event gifts unlock from September 23, including the free Headwear 'Unusual Hilichurl Mask'. From October 1 the reward tracks open: the in-game 'Starlit Gala: Wonderland Selects' event (2026/10/01 - 2026/10/22) pays Primogems, a Prismatic Crystal, a Geode of Replication, the Cryo Slime Hat and Actions/Expressions as players accumulate Festive Fever and vote for the 'Wonderlands of the Year'; the parallel Starlit Gala web event (2026/10/01 - 2026/11/03) pays Primogems, another Geode of Replication and more items. The 'Amongst the Thousand Stars' Wonderland Creator Contest runs until 2026-11-02 with Creation Ticket No.1, Primogems and other rewards. Version 7.1's Event Ode 'Moonlight After the Rain' separately carries the Legendary 5-star cosmetic set 'Osmanthus in the Moonlight'.
events.gameplay: Play Miliastra Wonderland (UGC) activities and the Starlit Gala web page minigames to progress both reward tracks; vote in Wonderland Selects.
requirements: Unknown (not yet published)

events.title: Stygian Onslaught
events.summary: Ley-line-disturbance boss challenge with three consecutive boss fights and a 450 Primogem reward track.
events.description: The September/October 2026 cycle of Disturbance-affected Ley Line challenges. Travelers fight three consecutive bosses - Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor: Gale Hewing, Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply and Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation - across six difficulty levels. Clearing Normal, Advancing and Hard difficulty covers the full 450-Primogem reward track; the upper difficulties add Dust of Enlightenment and Radiant Phantasm challenge rewards. The Disturbance Outbreak artifact-farming window ran only through October 10.
events.gameplay: Build teams and clear three consecutive boss encounters at rising difficulty; during Disturbance Outbreak, Hard+ clears let AR 45 players spend Resin on a selected Domain of Blessing while building Dire Prestige.
requirements: Adventure Rank 20 or above
Complete Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"

events.title: Predictive Victory Dynamics
events.summary: Combat prediction event in Natlan betting on simulated fights, with a 420 Primogem reward track plus 360,000 Mora and talent guides.
events.description: Back in the home of Natlan's Children of Echoes, elite warrior Liliuo and Fatui operative Wislawa are using a combat simulator to model the odds of victory. Eight rounds of battles unlock over time; Travelers allocate 'Victory Emblems' to the predicted winner of each round (each prediction window stays open 24 hours) and earn a Prediction Score from the results. Participation and score thresholds carry the reward track. The Result Announcement period runs 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-23 after the event ends.
events.gameplay: Study the two combatant line-ups, place your bet on the predicted winner of each simulated battle, and collect points for correct calls.
requirements: Adventure Rank 20 or above

events.title: "The Godforsaken Frostlands"
events.summary: Snezhnaya exploration campaign: complete exploration missions in the five new regions for a bonus 400 Primogems, claimable until 2026-11-03.
events.description: When Version 7.0 unlocked Snezhnaya's first five areas - Volkodlak Tundra, Everfrozen Earth, Fellfrost Peak, Flamefeather Valley and White Birch Snowgrave - a limited-time exploration campaign began: 'Complete the corresponding exploration missions within the specified duration to obtain an additional reward of Primogems ×400.' Each area carries objectives at 40%, 60% and 80% exploration progress (80% completes an area's objectives; 100% is not required). The bonus is paid on top of the regions' regular exploration rewards, and its deadline is shared with the Archon Quest completion bonus and both free 5-star selectors (2026/11/03). The official duration is stated as 'after the Version 7.0 update - 2026/11/03'.
events.gameplay: Explore the five new Snezhnaya areas and push each region's exploration progress to the mission thresholds to claim the bonus Primogems.
requirements: Adventure Rank 20 or above
Complete the introductory Snezhnaya Archon Quest

rewards.note: additional bonus for completing the exploration missions per the official event notice; paid on top of normal exploration rewards
